result.summary: Found 2 visual issues, mainly in the bottom navigation area.

issues.description: The bottom navigation item labeled "Orders" is missing its icon, while Home, Search, and Profile all have visible icons. This makes the nav look incomplete or broken.
issues.suggestion: Add the Orders icon above the label and ensure it uses the same size, color, and alignment as the other inactive navigation icons.

issues.description: The content behind the fixed bottom navigation is partially obscured at the bottom of the screen, with the next restaurant card cut off by the nav bar.
issues.suggestion: Add enough bottom padding or safe-area spacing to the scrollable content so cards are not visually hidden behind the fixed bottom navigation.
